parent_channels.name: Propulsive Force and Incursion

subchannels.name: Accelerating Charge
subchannels.scene_or_process: A running mount extends its gait, pants under exertion, gathers speed, and turns that accumulated force into a charge.
subchannels.active_motifs: running/coursing (`ع د و:B002/m01`); extended-limb gait (`ض ب ح:B002/m01`); panting breath (`ض ب ح:B001/m01`); forceful charge (`ش د د:B003/m01`); gathered momentum (`ج م ع:B010/m01`)
subchannels.synthesis: Running supplies the forward action, extended gait and panting give it an animal mechanism, and gathered motion explains how successive strides become a forceful charge.

subchannels.name: Dawn Assault and Alarm
subchannels.scene_or_process: A hostile movement arrives in the morning while repeated cries announce the assault and orient it toward an opposing group.
subchannels.active_motifs: wrongful incursion (`ع د و:B001/m01`); enemy relation (`ع د و:B003/m01`); morning assault (`ص ب ح:B004/m01`); alarm cry (`ص ب ح:B004/m02`); raised repeated cry (`ن ق ع:B005/m01`); gathered host (`ج م ع:B002/m01`)
subchannels.synthesis: The morning is both the time of attack and the setting for an alarm. Hostility gives the movement its social target, while the repeated cry turns the incursion into a publicly perceived event.

subchannels.name: Dust Plume and Center Penetration
subchannels.scene_or_process: Rapid movement agitates settled earth, raises a dust plume, and carries the movers into the middle of an assembled group.
subchannels.active_motifs: stirring earth from place (`ث و ر:B002/m01`); raised dust (`ن ق ع:B004/m01`); entry into the middle (`و س ط:B003/m01`); assembled group (`ج م ع:B002/m01`)
subchannels.synthesis: Agitation produces the visible dust outcome, while entry into the middle completes the spatial process: movement begins outside the group and terminates inside its center.

parent_channels.semantic_invariant: Stored bodily force becomes directed motion, audible strain, a raised trace, and penetration into a gathered body.
parent_channels.surprising_reach: The charge is legible not only as displacement but through breath, alarm, dust, and the gathering of separate strides into momentum.

parent_channels.name: Ignition, Light, and Combustion Trace

subchannels.name: Flint-to-Fire Mechanism
subchannels.scene_or_process: A striking tool meets a fire-bearing material, exposes its hidden flame, and marks the end of the implement with heat.
subchannels.active_motifs: striking fire (`ق د ح:B001/m01`); latent fire emerging (`و ر ي:B002/m01`); charred firestick tip (`ض ب ح:B003/m01`); successful firestick or aid (`و ر ي:B003/m01`)
subchannels.synthesis: The striker supplies impact, the fire-bearing material supplies concealed energy, and the charred tip records successful contact. The success-and-aid sense carries the same mechanism into social action: help makes an effort catch.

subchannels.name: Spark Becoming Lamp
subchannels.scene_or_process: Small, weak sparks become perceptible against the larger function of a lamp or dawn light.
subchannels.active_motifs: weak unusable sparks (`ح ب ب:B011/m01`); lamp or luminary (`ص ب ح:B005/m01`); kindled hidden fire (`و ر ي:B002/m01`)
subchannels.synthesis: The spark is momentary and slight, while the lamp stabilizes fire into usable illumination. Their contrast distinguishes mere emission from sustained light.

subchannels.name: Blackening and Ash
subchannels.scene_or_process: Heat darkens an exposed surface and reduces burned material to an ashen remainder.
subchannels.active_motifs: heat-blackened surface (`ض ب ح:B004/m01`); ash (`ض ب ح:B005/m01`); combustion remainder (`ح ص ل:B003/m02`)
subchannels.synthesis: Blackening is the intermediate visible state and ash the terminal residue. The remainder sense places combustion inside the wider pattern of what persists after other material has been removed.

parent_channels.semantic_invariant: Contact releases latent fire, fire becomes visible light, and burning leaves altered surfaces and residue.
parent_channels.surface_relation: direct; 100:2 `مُورِيَاتِ` and `قَدْحًا`, with lexical extensions anchored at 100:1 `ضَبْحًا`, 100:3 `صُبْحًا`, 100:8 `حُبِّ`, and 100:10 `حُصِّلَ`.
parent_channels.surprising_reach: The successful firestick also extends to successful aid, so ignition becomes a model for an undertaking made effective through assistance.

parent_channels.name: Water Collection, Surface, and Use

subchannels.name: Lowland Catchment and Abundant Water
subchannels.scene_or_process: Soft low ground receives water, a pool holds it in place, and the collected volume becomes a well, sea, or abundant sweet resource.
subchannels.active_motifs: soft low catchment (`خ ب ر:B002/m01`); standing pool (`ن ق ع:B001/m01`); abundant or sweet water (`ر ب ب:B013/m01`); sea or water-rich well (`ع ل م:B005/m01`)
subchannels.synthesis: Receptive terrain is the setting, settling is the process, and abundant stored water is the outcome. The well and sea senses scale the same collection principle from bounded source to immense body.

subchannels.name: Cloud, Film, Bubble, and Wave
subchannels.scene_or_process: Moisture gathers above as layered cloud and upon water as algae, bubbles, ripples, or waves.
subchannels.active_motifs: rising cloud or water spread (`ث و ر:B001/m02`); algae on the surface (`ث و ر:B007/m01`); bubbles and water tracks (`ح ب ب:B008/m01`); layered rain cloud (`ر ب ب:B008/m01`)
subchannels.synthesis: The motifs form a vertical surface system: cloud layers hold moisture above, algae rests on the water, and bubbles or waves articulate motion across its face.

subchannels.name: Quenching, Filling, and Departure
subchannels.scene_or_process: A drink is offered in the morning, thirst is quenched, body or vessel reaches fullness, and the drinker departs the water source.
subchannels.active_motifs: quenching thirst (`ن ق ع:B002/m01`); drinking to fullness (`ح ب ب:B006/m01`); morning drink (`ص ب ح:B003/m01`); departure from a watering place (`ص د ر:B003/m01`)
subchannels.synthesis: Morning drink names the occasion, quenching names the bodily change, fullness marks completion, and departure closes the watering sequence.

parent_channels.semantic_invariant: Water settles into receptive ground, develops a layered surface, and then moves into bodies or vessels as drink.

subchannels.active_motifs: bounded soaking place or vessel (`ن ق ع:B001/m02`); large waterskin (`خ ب ر:B004/m01`); storage jar (`ح ب ب:B007/m01`); large pot (`ج م ع:B012/m01`); drinking cup (`ق د ح:B006/m01`)
subchannels.synthesis: The vessels differ in scale and use but share one scene signature: contents are bounded, preserved, and positioned for soaking, storage, or serving.

subchannels.name: Lot Arrows in Hand and Holder
subchannels.scene_or_process: Unmarked shafts are collected in a leather holder and one is removed by a closed hand, like a scoop drawing from the bottom of a vessel.
subchannels.active_motifs: lot-arrow shaft (`ق د ح:B007/m01`); leather lot-arrow holder (`ر ب ب:B010/m01`); closed fist or grip (`ج م ع:B005/m01`); scooping or drawing from a vessel (`ق د ح:B005/m01`)
subchannels.synthesis: The holder gathers the shafts, the hand performs selection, and the drawing sense supplies the removal action. The mechanism is a bounded set converted into a single outcome by extraction.

parent_channels.semantic_invariant: A receptacle gathers discrete contents and permits them to be stored, served, gripped, or drawn out.

subchannels.name: Seed, Palm, and Green Shoot
subchannels.scene_or_process: Seed gives rise to mixed palm growth, unripe fruit, tender tips, evergreen vegetation, and later summer browse.
subchannels.active_motifs: grain or seed (`ح ب ب:B001/m01`); mixed palm cultivar (`ج م ع:B011/m01`); unripe date fruit (`ح ص ل:B005/m01`); evergreen plant (`ر ب ب:B012/m01`); tender shoot tips (`ق د ح:B009/m01`); summer herbage (`ع د و:B011/m01`)
subchannels.synthesis: Seed is the material origin, cultivar and shoot describe growth, the unripe date marks an intermediate fruit stage, and evergreen or summer vegetation extends the cycle across seasons.

subchannels.name: Tilling, Watering, and Nurture
subchannels.scene_or_process: A cultivator stirs soil, supplies water and provisions, and raises the productive thing gradually toward completion.
subchannels.active_motifs: soil stirring (`ث و ر:B002/m03`); cultivator and sharecropper (`خ ب ر:B003/m01`); provisioning or watering (`غ ي ر:B001/m01`); gradual nurture (`ر ب ب:B002/m01`)
subchannels.synthesis: Soil disturbance prepares the setting, the cultivator supplies agency, watering sustains the process, and nurture names the gradual movement toward a finished crop.

subchannels.name: Separation, Grain, and Residue
subchannels.scene_or_process: Harvested material is scattered for handling, grain is gathered, the useful kernel is extracted, and chaff or residue remains.
subchannels.active_motifs: scattering material (`ب ع ث ر:B002/m01`); gathering material (`ج م ع:B001/m01`); grain (`ح ب ب:B001/m01`); extracting the kernel (`ح ص ل:B002/m01`); chaff or remainder (`ح ص ل:B003/m01`)
subchannels.synthesis: Scattering and gathering are complementary operations rather than opposites: they loosen the mixed material so that the kernel can be distinguished from what remains.

subchannels.name: Curd, Syrup, Honey, and Welcome Food
subchannels.scene_or_process: Solid dairy, thick condiment, comb honey, milk, and slaughtered food are assembled into a prepared meal for arrival or hospitality.
subchannels.active_motifs: dried-curd lump (`ث و ر:B005/m01`); thick syrup or paste (`ر ب ب:B006/m01`); honey in comb (`ش ه د:B007/m01`); welcome meal (`ن ق ع:B003/m01`); hospitality slaughter (`ن ق ع:B003/m02`); chilled pure milk (`ن ق ع:B003/m03`)
subchannels.synthesis: The motifs occupy distinct food roles: curd is a solid staple, syrup a dressing, honey a sweet stored in wax, and milk or slaughtered meat the substance of a welcoming meal.

parent_channels.semantic_invariant: Living material moves from seed and cultivated growth through separation and residue into food prepared for storage or hospitality.
parent_channels.surprising_reach: The roots of love, testimony, lordship, and running extend into grain, honeycomb, plant care, and late-season herbage.

parent_channels.name: Herd Continuity, Birth, and Fosterage

subchannels.name: Cattle and Herd Cohort
subchannels.scene_or_process: Bulls and other livestock form a bounded herd containing animals of different size and activity.
subchannels.active_motifs: bull or male cattle (`ث و ر:B004/m01`); livestock herd (`ر ب ب:B014/m01`); grouped animals (`ج م ع:B002/m01`); small or lean animal (`ح ب ب:B010/m01`); camel remaining at its resting place (`ص ب ح:B008/m01`)
subchannels.synthesis: The herd is the collective setting, the bull and small animal occupy differentiated member roles, and the resting camel adds a state of managed immobility within the cohort.

subchannels.name: Pregnancy, Birth Signs, and Maturity
subchannels.scene_or_process: Pregnancy advances to recent birth, bodily traces register delivery or puberty, and the young body reaches completeness and mature strength.
subchannels.active_motifs: retained pregnancy (`ج م ع:B007/m01`); recently lambed ewe (`ر ب ب:B009/m01`); afterbirth (`ش ه د:B006/m01`); puberty sign (`ش ه د:B006/m02`); mature strength (`ش د د:B004/m01`); bodily wholeness (`ج م ع:B009/m01`)
subchannels.synthesis: Pregnancy supplies the initial state, afterbirth marks delivery, puberty signs mark a later threshold, and wholeness with mature strength gives the developmental outcome.

subchannels.name: Union, Descent, and Fostered Care
subchannels.scene_or_process: Sexual union opens a line of descent that includes pregnancy, grandchildren, a fostered child, and the adult who assumes care.
subchannels.active_motifs: sexual union (`ج م ع:B006/m01`); pregnancy (`ج م ع:B007/m01`); grandchild (`و ر ي:B007/m01`); fostered child (`ر ب ب:B005/m01`); fosterer or nurse (`ر ب ب:B005/m02`); gradual child-rearing (`ر ب ب:B002/m01`)
subchannels.synthesis: Biological continuation and social care occupy separate roles in one lineage scene. Descent produces the child relation, while fosterage transfers day-to-day nurture to another adult.

parent_channels.semantic_invariant: A living group persists through herd formation, reproductive stages, maturation, descent, and delegated care.
parent_channels.surprising_reach: Herd vocabulary passes into human household structure through foster children, caretakers, grandchildren, and signs of maturity.

parent_channels.name: Knowing and Making Hidden States Legible

subchannels.name: Perception, Knowledge, and Expertise
subchannels.scene_or_process: A person sees, hears, or senses something, recognizes it as knowledge, and develops inward expertise or learned mastery.
subchannels.active_motifs: sensory recognition (`ء ن س:B002/m01`); knowledge and recognition (`ع ل م:B001/m01`); inward expertise (`خ ب ر:B001/m01`); learned scholar (`ر ب ب:B003/m01`)
subchannels.synthesis: Sensory contact initiates cognition, knowledge stabilizes recognition, inward expertise reaches beneath appearances, and the scholar embodies cultivated command of that knowledge.

subchannels.name: Testimony, Report, and Utterance
subchannels.scene_or_process: Known content is converted into a decisive report and made outwardly present through testimony and the speaking tongue.
subchannels.active_motifs: testimony or decisive declaration (`ش ه د:B002/m01`); report or news (`خ ب ر:B001/m02`); speaking tongue or expression (`ش ه د:B005/m01`); recognized knowledge (`ع ل م:B001/m01`)
subchannels.synthesis: Knowledge supplies the content, report gives it propositional form, testimony commits a speaker to it, and the tongue makes the inner state publicly accessible.

subchannels.name: Mark, Indicator, and Reflected Person
subchannels.scene_or_process: A mark identifies an object or route, an indicator reveals time or condition, and the pupil carries a visible image of the person before it.
subchannels.active_motifs: identifying mark or banner (`ع ل م:B002/m01`); condition-bearing indicator (`ش ه د:B008/m01`); human image in the pupil (`ء ن س:B005/m01`); visible complexion (`ص ب ح:B006/m01`)
subchannels.synthesis: Mark and indicator are conventional signs, complexion is a bodily sign, and the pupil is a reflective sign. Each makes an otherwise absent identity or condition available at a surface.

subchannels.name: Exhumation and Extraction
subchannels.scene_or_process: Covered ground is agitated, a grave or hollow is opened, and a concealed body or valuable core is brought out.
subchannels.active_motifs: turning soil to uncover (`ب ع ث ر:B001/m01`); burial enclosure (`ق ب ر:B001/m01`); hidden hollow (`ق ب ر:B002/m01`); concealed thing (`و ر ي:B005/m01`); agitation that exposes (`ث و ر:B002/m02`); extracting a precious core (`ح ص ل:B002/m02`)
subchannels.synthesis: Burial and concealment define the initial enclosure, agitation and turning break that enclosure, and extraction names the final transfer of hidden contents into view.

subchannels.name: Interior Collection and Final Disclosure
subchannels.scene_or_process: What is dispersed within the chest is gathered into a determinate result and becomes fully known.
subchannels.active_motifs: manifested result (`ح ص ل:B001/m01`); bodily chest or breast (`ص د ر:B001/m01`); inward expertise (`خ ب ر:B001/m01`); knowledge (`ع ل م:B001/m01`)
subchannels.synthesis: The chest is the interior container, collection converts its dispersed contents into a result, and knowledge reaches that result without remaining at the outward surface.

parent_channels.semantic_invariant: Perception, testimony, signs, excavation, and extraction convert concealed states into knowable or manifest ones.
parent_channels.surprising_reach: The disclosure pattern spans sensory recognition, speech, body marks, reflected images, graves, mineral casings, and the contents of chests.

parent_channels.name: Assembly, Center, and Command

subchannels.name: Multitude, Meeting Place, and Summons
subchannels.scene_or_process: Dispersed persons are summoned to a shared place, become present together, and form a multitude or confederated group.
subchannels.active_motifs: gathering people (`ج م ع:B001/m02`); crowd or community (`ج م ع:B002/m01`); assembly place or time (`ج م ع:B004/m01`); summons to assemble (`ج م ع:B004/m02`); multitude or confederation (`ر ب ب:B004/m01`); witnessed presence (`ش ه د:B001/m01`)
subchannels.synthesis: Summons initiates movement, the meeting place supplies a common setting, presence establishes participation, and the multitude is the resulting social body.

subchannels.name: Entry into the Center
subchannels.scene_or_process: An actor crosses from the edge of a group into its middle and occupies the position between its sides.
subchannels.active_motifs: middle position (`و س ط:B002/m01`); entering the middle (`و س ط:B003/m01`); gathered group (`ج م ع:B002/m01`)
subchannels.synthesis: The group supplies the bounded field, the middle supplies the target position, and entry supplies the transition from outside to inside.

subchannels.name: Foremost Position and Reinforced Authority
subchannels.scene_or_process: A master occupies the foremost or central position and reinforces the order governed from it.
subchannels.active_motifs: lordship or mastery (`ر ب ب:B001/m01`); foremost position (`ص د ر:B002/m01`); governing center (`و س ط:B002/m01`); reinforcement of rule (`ش د د:B001/m02`)
subchannels.synthesis: Front and center provide the spatial model, lordship supplies the governing relation, and reinforcement describes how that relation is made durable.

subchannels.name: Maritime Command and Sectional Allocation
subchannels.scene_or_process: A chief of sailors presides while a whole is divided and distinguished into portions.
subchannels.active_motifs: chief of sailors (`ر ب ب:B017/m01`); bisection (`و س ط:B006/m01`); portion or section (`ص د ر:B006/m01`)
subchannels.synthesis: Maritime leadership supplies the directing role, bisection supplies the operation, and the portion supplies its result, yielding a compact scene of division under command.

parent_channels.semantic_invariant: Separate persons become a collective organized by a place, a center, a front, and a directing authority.
parent_channels.surprising_reach: Spatial precedence at the middle and front scales into social precedence, including lordship and the chief of sailors.

parent_channels.name: Covenant, Opposition, and Settlement

subchannels.name: Binding Pact and Alliance
subchannels.scene_or_process: Parties join around a matter, bind themselves by covenant, and reinforce the resulting alliance.
subchannels.active_motifs: covenant or pact (`ر ب ب:B011/m01`); joining another on a matter (`ج م ع:B013/m01`); binding and reinforcement (`ش د د:B001/m01`)
subchannels.synthesis: Joining creates the aligned parties, the pact defines their obligation, and binding gives that obligation durability.

subchannels.name: Hostility and Covenant Rupture
subchannels.scene_or_process: A former or possible relation becomes enmity, crosses into aggression, and is severed by departure or broken obligation.
subchannels.active_motifs: enemy relation (`ع د و:B003/m01`); transgressive aggression (`ع د و:B001/m01`); severing a relation (`ك ن د:B001/m02`); forceful attack (`ش د د:B003/m01`)
subchannels.synthesis: Enmity supplies the social opposition, aggression realizes it as action, and severing names the broken continuity between parties.

subchannels.name: Claim, Testimony, and Restitution
subchannels.scene_or_process: An injured party seeks a ruling, testimony and inward knowledge establish the matter, property is assessed or confiscated, and compensation settles the claim.
subchannels.active_motifs: appeal for redress (`ع د و:B005/m01`); testimony (`ش ه د:B002/m01`); inward knowledge of the case (`خ ب ر:B001/m01`); confiscation or assessed payment (`ص د ر:B005/m01`); indemnity or blood-money (`غ ي ر:B002/m01`)
subchannels.synthesis: The claimant initiates adjudication, testimony and knowledge determine the case, and confiscation or indemnity converts judgment into material settlement.

subchannels.name: Mediation between Parties
subchannels.scene_or_process: An intermediary enters between opposed sides and works toward renewed agreement.
subchannels.active_motifs: mediation (`و س ط:B005/m01`); alliance around a matter (`ج م ع:B013/m01`); covenant (`ر ب ب:B011/m01`); opposing party (`ع د و:B003/m01`)
subchannels.synthesis: Opposition supplies the two sides, the mediator occupies the relational middle, and alliance or covenant supplies the sought outcome.

subchannels.name: Defamation, Insult, and Displayed Anger
subchannels.scene_or_process: Conflict is verbalized as lineage attack and coarse insult, while anger becomes visible in the face.
subchannels.active_motifs: defamation of lineage (`ق د ح:B003/m01`); coarse insult (`ن ق ع:B009/m01`); tongue as expression (`ش ه د:B005/m01`); nose-tip display of anger (`ق ب ر:B004/m01`)
subchannels.synthesis: The tongue supplies the expressive tool, defamation and insult supply the hostile acts, and the angered face supplies their bodily counterpart.

parent_channels.semantic_invariant: Relations between parties are bound as pacts, opposed as enmity, argued through claims, and restored through judgment or mediation.
parent_channels.surface_relation: indirect; the contributing roots occur at 100:1 `عَادِيَاتِ`, 100:3 `مُغِيرَاتِ`, 100:5 `وَسَطْنَ` and `جَمْعًا`, 100:6 and 100:11 `رَبّ`, 100:7 `شَهِيدٌ`, 100:8 `شَدِيدٌ`, 100:10 `صُدُورِ`, and 100:11 `خَبِيرٌ`.
parent_channels.surprising_reach: Roots used on the surface for running, gathering, and entering the middle become the roles of foe, ally, claimant, and mediator.

parent_channels.name: Value, Preference, and Reciprocity

subchannels.name: Intense Attachment to the Good
subchannels.scene_or_process: A person recognizes something as good or beneficial, prefers it, and holds that attachment with intensity.
subchannels.active_motifs: love and preference (`ح ب ب:B002/m01`); beneficial good (`خ ي ر:B001/m01`); intensity or force (`ش د د:B002/m01`)
subchannels.synthesis: The good supplies the valued object, love supplies the enduring relation to it, and intensity describes the force of that attachment.

subchannels.name: Choice, Excellence, and the Mean
subchannels.scene_or_process: Alternatives are compared, the better is selected, and judgment locates a just mean between excess and deficiency.
subchannels.active_motifs: choosing the better (`خ ي ر:B003/m01`); excellence (`خ ي ر:B002/m01`); just or balanced mean (`و س ط:B001/m01`); middling rank (`و س ط:B004/m01`); substitution or change (`غ ي ر:B003/m01`)
subchannels.synthesis: Change presents alternatives, choice selects among them, excellence names the upper value, and the mean regulates selection by relation to both extremes.

subchannels.name: Benefaction and Broken Return
subchannels.scene_or_process: A lord or caretaker grants provision and nurture, but the recipient withholds acknowledgment and severs the expected return.
subchannels.active_motifs: lordship or mastery (`ر ب ب:B001/m01`); gradual nurture (`ر ب ب:B002/m01`); generosity or gift (`خ ي ر:B005/m01`); provision and repair (`غ ي ر:B001/m01`); ingratitude and withholding (`ك ن د:B002/m01`)
subchannels.synthesis: Mastery and nurture define the benefactor's role, gift and provision define what moves toward the recipient, and ingratitude reverses the relation by withholding its expected acknowledgment.

parent_channels.semantic_invariant: A valued good draws attachment and choice, while generosity and nurture create an obligation that can be answered or denied.
parent_channels.surprising_reach: Moral good expands into concrete gift, provision, watering, and care, while ingratitude is figured as withholding and severance.

parent_channels.name: Material Cohesion and Disruption

subchannels.name: Knot, Bond, and Shackle
subchannels.scene_or_process: Separate parts are tightened into a durable knot and restraint closes hands or limbs against movement.
subchannels.active_motifs: tightened bond (`ش د د:B001/m01`); firm knot (`ر ب ب:B016/m01`); hand-and-neck shackle (`ج م ع:B008/m01`)
subchannels.synthesis: Tightening is the operation, the knot is its stable structure, and the shackle applies that structure to bodily restraint.

subchannels.name: Cutting, Fracture, Hollowing, and Inversion
subchannels.scene_or_process: A whole is severed or bisected, a nick opens its surface, a hollow weakens its interior, and inversion overturns the remaining structure.
subchannels.active_motifs: severing (`ك ن د:B001/m01`); bisection (`و س ط:B006/m01`); nick or crack (`ق د ح:B002/m01`); internal hollow (`ق ب ر:B002/m01`); inverted or demolished basin (`ب ع ث ر:B003/m01`)
subchannels.synthesis: Severing and bisection divide from outside, nicking initiates a local break, hollowing removes inner support, and inversion completes structural collapse.

subchannels.name: Scatter, Gather, and Result
subchannels.scene_or_process: A collected set is dispersed, its pieces are gathered again, and their remainder or outcome is made determinate.
subchannels.active_motifs: scattering possessions (`ب ع ث ر:B002/m01`); gathering material (`ج م ع:B001/m01`); collected outcome (`ح ص ل:B001/m02`)
subchannels.synthesis: Scattering changes one whole into many pieces, gathering reverses their spatial separation, and collection fixes what the rearrangement has yielded.

parent_channels.semantic_invariant: Material wholes are bound, cut, inverted, scattered, and gathered into a new result.
parent_channels.surprising_reach: The eschatological scattering and collection sequence also yields a concrete mechanics of knots, shackles, fractures, and inverted basins.

parent_channels.name: Terrain, Orientation, and Staying

subchannels.name: Soft Basin, Flat Plain, and Hard Ground
subchannels.scene_or_process: A traveler or animal moves across a terrain gradient from soft depression through level clay to hard uneven and barren ground.
subchannels.active_motifs: soft low ground (`خ ب ر:B002/m01`); terrain depression (`ق ب ر:B002/m02`); level clay plain (`ن ق ع:B007/m01`); hard uneven ground (`ع د و:B010/m01`); barren soil (`ك ن د:B003/m01`)
subchannels.synthesis: Softness and depression describe receptive ground, the plain removes vertical obstruction, hardness introduces resistance, and barrenness names the land's failed productive outcome.

subchannels.name: Edge, Middle, Facing Side, and Beyond
subchannels.scene_or_process: An observer locates a thing by its bank or edge, its middle, the side facing a person, and the side behind or beyond a barrier.
subchannels.active_motifs: bank or edge (`ع د و:B009/m01`); middle position (`و س ط:B002/m01`); human-facing side (`ء ن س:B004/m01`); behind, before, or beyond (`و ر ي:B006/m01`)
subchannels.synthesis: Edge and middle locate a thing within a field, the human-facing side makes orientation observer-relative, and beyond locates what lies across the intervening boundary.

subchannels.name: Residence and Immobilized Animal
subchannels.scene_or_process: A body remains at a place through duration, routine, exhaustion, illness, or difficult ground.
subchannels.active_motifs: staying or enduring (`ر ب ب:B007/m01`); disabled camel remaining in place (`ح ب ب:B005/m01`); camel lingering at its morning rest (`ص ب ح:B008/m01`); hard unsettled ground (`ع د و:B010/m01`)
subchannels.synthesis: Staying supplies the durable state, the two camel motifs distinguish incapacity from routine delay, and difficult ground supplies a setting that reinforces immobility.

parent_channels.semantic_invariant: Places are differentiated by hardness, level, edge, middle, facing, and the capacity to hold a body in position.
parent_channels.surprising_reach: Valley banks and hard ground scale into a human-facing side, an opposite side beyond a barrier, and a body or cloud that remains fixed in place.

parent_channels.name: Bodily Interiors, Surfaces, and Health

subchannels.name: Person Reflected in Eye and Tongue
subchannels.scene_or_process: The pupil receives a visible human image while the tongue renders the person's inner content as expression.
subchannels.active_motifs: human image in the pupil (`ء ن س:B005/m01`); tongue or outward expression (`ش ه د:B005/m01`)
subchannels.synthesis: Eye and tongue are paired representational surfaces: one reflects the person's form and the other externalizes the person's speech.

subchannels.name: Mouth, Teeth, Color, and Defect
subchannels.scene_or_process: The mouth presents ordered white teeth and facial color, while canker, cleft, or darkening interrupts that visible integrity.
subchannels.active_motifs: ordered teeth (`ح ب ب:B009/m01`); tooth or tree canker (`ق د ح:B004/m01`); upper-lip cleft (`ع ل م:B004/m01`); altered dark color (`ض ب ح:B004/m02`); bright or reddish complexion (`ص ب ح:B006/m01`)
subchannels.synthesis: Ordered teeth and bright complexion establish visible integrity; canker, cleft, and darkening describe distinct ways that integrity is marked or damaged.

subchannels.name: Heart Core within the Chest
subchannels.scene_or_process: A dark central point of the heart lies enclosed within the broader chest interior.
subchannels.active_motifs: dark core of the heart (`ح ب ب:B004/m01`); chest or breast (`ص د ر:B001/m01`)
subchannels.synthesis: The chest is the enclosing bodily region and the heart-core is its concentrated interior point, giving inward attachment a precise anatomical depth.

subchannels.name: Internal Disease, Contagion, and Poison
subchannels.scene_or_process: Disease occupies lung or gut, passes between bodies, weakens an animal, and culminates in a fixed or killing poison.
subchannels.active_motifs: internal lung or gut disease (`و ر ي:B001/m01`); transmitted disease (`ع د و:B006/m01`); settled or killing poison (`ن ق ع:B006/m01`); sick camel immobilized (`ح ب ب:B005/m01`); emaciated horse or sunken eye (`ق د ح:B008/m01`)
subchannels.synthesis: Internal disease supplies the originating condition, contagion supplies transmission, wasting and immobility supply bodily outcomes, and poison gives the process a concentrated lethal form.

parent_channels.semantic_invariant: The body contains hidden cores, presents identifying surfaces, and registers damage or illness through visible and transmissible changes.
parent_channels.surface_relation: direct; 100:8 `حُبِّ`, 100:10 `صُدُورِ`, with lexical extensions anchored at 100:1 `عَادِيَاتِ` and `ضَبْحًا`, 100:2 `مُورِيَاتِ` and `قَدْحًا`, 100:3 `صُبْحًا`, 100:4 `نَقْعًا`, 100:6 `إِنسَانَ`, 100:7 `شَهِيدٌ`, and 100:9 `يَعْلَمُ`.
parent_channels.surprising_reach: Eye and tongue represent the person, while moral interiority is given a physical counterpart in the heart's dark core and the contents of the chest.

parent_channels.name: Grammatical Reference and Derivation

subchannels.name: Otherness, Exception, and Quantification
subchannels.scene_or_process: A statement sets an item apart from a class, marks it as other, and qualifies the frequency or quantity of what remains.
subchannels.active_motifs: bypass or exception (`ع د و:B004/m01`); otherness or exclusion (`غ ي ر:B005/m01`); quantifying particle (`ر ب ب:B015/m01`); totalized collectivity (`ج م ع:B009/m02`)
subchannels.synthesis: Exception removes an item from the asserted field, otherness names the contrast, totality defines the larger set, and the particle modulates how often or how many instances are asserted.

subchannels.name: Relative, Demonstrative, and Interrogative Reference
subchannels.scene_or_process: A discourse identifies a referent by relation, points it out, or asks which thing is intended.
subchannels.active_motifs: relative connector (`ذ و و:B002/m01`); demonstrative pointer (`ذ و و:B003/m01`); interrogative referent (`ذ و و:B004/m01`)
subchannels.synthesis: Relative reference links a referent to a clause, demonstration points to it, and interrogation opens its identity as a question; all three organize access to the same discourse object.

subchannels.name: Source, Becoming, and Result
subchannels.scene_or_process: An expression begins from a verbal source, passes into a changed state, and resolves into a gathered result.
subchannels.active_motifs: verbal source or infinitive (`ص د ر:B004/m01`); becoming a state (`ص ب ح:B010/m01`); resultant outcome (`ح ص ل:B001/m03`)
subchannels.synthesis: Source supplies grammatical origin, becoming supplies transition, and result supplies the state reached after the transition.

parent_channels.semantic_invariant: Language locates referents, excludes alternatives, quantifies occurrence, and derives states or outcomes from a source.
parent_channels.surface_relation: indirect; roots occur at 100:1 `عَادِيَاتِ`, 100:3 `مُغِيرَاتِ` and `صُبْحًا`, 100:5 `جَمْعًا`, 100:6 and 100:11 `رَبّ`, 100:7 `ذَٰلِكَ`, and 100:10 `حُصِّلَ` and `صُدُورِ`.
parent_channels.surprising_reach: Physical otherness, possession, front, source, and gathered remainder become operations of reference, exception, derivation, and result.

parent_channels.name: S1. Hunting by Lure and Pursuit
parent_channels.scene_or_process: A hunter draws quarry from cover, follows successive prey, and operates among animal calls, a falcon, and a hyena.
parent_channels.active_motifs: lure from a burrow (`خ ي ر:B006/m01`); successive quarry (`ع د و:B008/m01`); falcon (`ع ل م:B006/m01`); male hyena (`ع ل م:B007/m01`); animal call or echo (`ض ب ح:B001/m02`)
parent_channels.synthesis: The lure initiates emergence, pursuit orders prey in sequence, the falcon supplies a hunting agent, and the hyena and animal cries populate the quarry landscape.

parent_channels.name: S2. Morning Cycle and Timed Arrival
parent_channels.scene_or_process: Dawn opens a cycle of morning arrival, drinking or activity, possible morning sleep, and the later rise of full day.
parent_channels.active_motifs: dawn (`ص ب ح:B001/m01`); morning arrival (`ص ب ح:B002/m01`); morning sleep (`ص ب ح:B007/m01`); specified recurring morning (`ص ب ح:B009/m01`); high day (`ش د د:B005/m01`)
parent_channels.synthesis: The repeated root supplies a temporal framework rather than one event: dawn is the boundary, arrival and sleep are alternative morning actions, and high day is the later state.

parent_channels.name: S3. Companionship and the Intimate
parent_channels.scene_or_process: Familiar presence removes isolation and establishes a companion, confidant, or specially preferred person.
parent_channels.active_motifs: companionship that removes loneliness (`ء ن س:B003/m01`); intimate or confidant (`ء ن س:B006/m01`); affectionate preference (`ح ب ب:B002/m01`)
parent_channels.synthesis: Familiarity changes the initial state of estrangement, companionship supplies sustained presence, and preference narrows that relation to a trusted intimate.

parent_channels.name: S4. Names across Place, People, and Constellation
parent_channels.scene_or_process: A single name identifies a mountain or place, a tribe or people, and a celestial sign, while another name fixes a distinct tribal identity.
parent_channels.active_motifs: Thawr as place, people, or constellation (`ث و ر:B006/m01`); Kinda as tribal name (`ك ن د:B004/m01`); tribal confederation (`ر ب ب:B004/m02`)
parent_channels.synthesis: Proper naming carries identity across geographic, social, and celestial referents, while the confederation sense supplies the collective entity that a tribal name can denote.
